description: This file defines an immutable singleton class `ImmutableThingPlaceholder` that implements the `ThingPlaceholder` interface. It replaces specific placeholders related to 'thing' identifiers—namely 'thing:id', 'thing:namespace', and 'thing:name'—by resolving a given `ThingId` object into a placeholder string.

classes.name: ImmutableThingPlaceholder
classes.description: An immutable, singleton class that handles placeholder resolution for 'thing' entities, specifically replacing identifiers with proper placeholder strings.

methods.name: getPrefix
methods.description: Returns the placeholder prefix string 'thing', indicating the type of placeholders this class handles.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves the placeholder for a given `thingId` and placeholder string. If `thingId` is an instance of `ThingId`, it delegates to `doResolve`. Otherwise, it returns an empty Optional.
